details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that covertly injects the author's own channel branding into messages produced by applications that embed it. lib/Utils/messages.js (prepareWAMessageMedia) supplies a default annotations block containing newsletterJid "120363403941803439@newsletter" with newsletterName "Ditciix7" and serverMessageId 0 for every media message that does not already define annotations. The custom file lib/Socket/damnn.js, wired into lib/Socket/messages-send.js, hardcodes forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo into generated message content and into status@broadcast payloads, using newsletterJid "120363403941803439@newsletter" / "0@newsletter", newsletterName "Ditcii Information"/"Ditcii", senderName "Ditcii" and priority "high". On require, lib/index.js prints the author's promotional banner ("Support My Channel @sf7zephkiel", "@AboutDitcii"). The install hook engine-requirements.js only checks for Node.js >= 20. No network destination beyond wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com and the standard WhatsApp media upload endpoint was found, and no credential, token or key material (npm/GitHub/cloud tokens,.npmrc, ~/.ssh) is read or transmitted. IOCs: newsletter JID 120363403941803439@newsletter; author handles @sf7zephkiel, @AboutDitcii, DitciiX7.
